clue.text: Document I don't know, left at sea

clue.text: It's far from dull as Margaret's parent

explanation.walkthrough: The name Margaret means 'pearl', so a playful reading makes her mother the parent of a pearl.
explanation.definitionFit: Nacre is the shimmering, iridescent shell lining, the opposite of matt.

clue.text: Choose one of two actions so randomly

a door is an opening

clue.text: One has a hand in this good, good feeling

parts.note: love is a warm, good feeling

first of takes the opening letter of ropes
